description_en: Gets caller report data for preview outbound calls
description_zh: 获取预览外呼主叫报表数据
name: CloudOutboundObClidReport

parameters.description_en: The ID of the call center.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.description_en: The time period type for the report. Valid values: 1: daily report, 2: weekly report, 3: monthly report, and 4: custom time.
parameters.description_zh: 统计类型；说明：统计报表时间类型，1：日报表2：周报表3：月报表4：自定义时间
parameters.help_en: The time period type for the report. Valid values: 1: daily report, 2: weekly report, 3: monthly report, and 4: custom time
parameters.help_zh: 统计类型；说明：统计报表时间类型，1：日报表2：周报表3：月报表4：自定义时间
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.description_en: The aggregation method. Valid values: 0: by hour, 1: by day, 2: summary, and 11: trunk group summary.
parameters.description_zh: 统计方法；说明：0：分时1：分日2：汇总11：中继群组汇总
parameters.help_en: The aggregation method. Valid values: 0: by hour, 1: by day, 2: summary, and 11: trunk group summary
parameters.help_zh: 统计方法；说明：0：分时1：分日2：汇总11：中继群组汇总
parameters.name: statistic_method

parameters.description_en: The area codes for which to query statistics about preview outbound calls. Separate multiple codes with a comma (,). If this parameter is omitted, the operation returns statistics for all regions in your account.
parameters.description_zh: 说明：根据区号查询指定区域的预览外呼被叫号码统计支持按照多个区号进行查询，多个区号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有地区的预览外呼被叫号码统计
